scope: New root native-target inspection, native authoring and manifest helpers only; synthetic mechanical control, no scientific approval.
inspected_properties: New-owner native targets use kind=source and explicit ownership_note; they do not fabricate current maintained owner_paths. Existing-owner targets bind actual preimages plus aggregate selectors.
Manifest discovers only new successor subtree and newly saved native review, rejects symlinks, duplicate paths and existing immutable manifest overwrite; predecessor is not rewritten.

Private inspection/review/target inputs are originals generated in persistent repository .temp, not /tmp. Reproduction evidence must preserve those exact inspected bytes with the eventual saved native review.

finding.issue: Native authoring reads failed structural/combined validation receipts without checking their failure fields, then emits checks passed and verdict pass_with_limitations.
finding.control: A private synthetic fixture supplied structural status FAIL, strict_exit_code1, an overlay violation and maintained_surfaces_unchanged false. With a peer proof containing status PASS, the current author helper still generated a passing native review.
finding.scope_limit: This does not show the actual bundle failed; it exposes a mechanical gate that could misreport a prior failed validator run. No actual native bundle was generated by this review.
finding.requested_fix: Assert structural PASS and combined strict exit0, empty baseline/overlay violations, maintained_surfaces_unchanged true, empty changed/added/removed lists, and published mismatch list empty before declaring passed checks. Bind peer verification to the current final input hashes or require explicit verified binding metadata.
